en.answer: If <<4773>> was Special Summoned this turn, since its effect does not allow it to attack this turn, it cannot be targeted with <<11902>>.
en.question: If <<4773>> is Special Summoned this turn, can it be targeted with <<11902>>? If so, can <<4773>> attack?
